description: This file contains unit tests for the CandidateHiringAPI class within the Recruitment API module of the OrangeHRM system. It tests various API endpoints like getOne, update, delete, and their validation rules, using PHPUnit framework extensions and mock services.

classes.name: CandidateHiringAPITest
classes.description: This class extends EndpointIntegrationTestCase to provide automated tests for the CandidateHiringAPI endpoint, covering CRUD methods and validation rules, using mock services and test data setup.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment by truncating CandidateHistory table to ensure test isolation.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests that the getOne method of CandidateHiringAPI throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Tests validation rule retrieval for the getOne method, expecting a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests the update API method using various test cases, with fixture setup and mock dependencies.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides different test case parameters loaded from 'CandidateHiringTestCases.yaml' for the update tests.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests that the delete method of CandidateHiringAPI throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Tests validation rule retrieval for the delete method, expecting a not implemented exception.
